description: Implementation of UnixDomainClientSocket class for POSIX systems, managing Unix domain socket connections including connect, disconnect, and data transfer functions.

classes.name: UnixDomainClientSocket
classes.description: A socket class for Unix domain socket client connections on POSIX systems, supporting connect, disconnect, read, write, and socket info retrieval.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Unix domain socket at the specified path.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Closes the socket connection and resets internal state.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the socket is currently connected.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the peer address; not applicable for Unix domain sockets.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address; not applicable for Unix domain sockets.

methods.name: WasEverUsed
methods.description: Indicates if the socket was ever used.

methods.name: GetSSLInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL information; not applicable for Unix domain sockets.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received; not implemented.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies socket tagging; ignored for Unix domain sockets.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size; not implemented.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size; not implemented.
